units.source_text: “我私下里拜托夫人和小姐尽量多跟K说话。

en.t: In private, I asked the madam and the young lady to talk with K as much as possible.

units.source_text: 因为我相信，正是他迄今为止所过的沉默的生活才使他变成这样的，

en.t: For I believed that it was the silent life he had led until then that had made him this way,

units.source_text: 如同铁不用会生锈一样，我认为他的内心已经生了锈。

en.t: just as iron rusts when it is not used, I thought his heart had already rusted.

units.source_text: 夫人笑着说他是个很难接近的人，小姐还特意给我举了个例子加以说明。

en.t: The madam laughed and said he was a very hard person to approach, and the young lady even gave me a specific example to explain it.

units.source_text: 有一回，小姐问他火盆里有没有火，K回答‘没有’。

en.t: Once, the young lady asked him whether there was any fire in the brazier, and K answered, 'No.'

units.source_text: 她说‘那我给你端来吧’，K说‘不用’。

en.t: She said, 'Then I will bring some for you,' and K said, 'No need.'

units.source_text: 小姐又问‘不冷吗？’他却说‘冷是冷，但不需要’，说到这里便不再说话。

en.t: The young lady asked again, 'Aren't you cold?' but he said, 'I am cold, but I do not need it,' and after that he said nothing more.

units.source_text: 听了这样的对答，我也不能光是苦笑了。

en.t: After hearing such an exchange, I could not simply leave it at a wry smile.

units.source_text: 我觉得K很可怜，要是不说点什么为他辩护一下，便觉得过意不去。

en.t: I felt sorry for K, and unless I said something in his defense, I felt uneasy.

units.source_text: 虽说已经到春天了，没有必要非烤火不可，但她们据此说K很难接近，也不是没有道理。

en.t: Although spring had already come and there was no real need to warm himself by the fire, it was not unreasonable for them to say from this that K was hard to approach.

units.source_text: 于是我尽量以自己为媒介，想方设法让两个女人和K多接近。

en.t: So I tried as much as possible to use myself as an intermediary and find ways to bring the two women and K closer together.

units.source_text: 每当K和我闲聊的时候，我就把母女俩请过来，

en.t: Whenever K and I were chatting idly, I would invite the mother and daughter over,

units.source_text: 当我同她们两人在一起的时候，也把K叫过来。

en.t: and when I was together with the two of them, I would also call K over.

units.source_text: 总之，我千方百计地让K同她们接近。

en.t: In short, I used every possible means to make K get closer to them.

units.source_text: 当然K是不大喜欢这种方式的，有时他会突然站起身走出去，

en.t: Of course, K did not much like this way of doing things, and sometimes he would suddenly stand up and walk out,

units.source_text: 也有时怎么叫他也不肯出来。

en.t: while at other times, no matter how much I called him, he would not come out.

units.source_text: 他说这么闲聊有什么意思！

en.t: He said, what was the point of such idle chatter!

units.source_text: 我只是付之一笑，但心里很明白，K因此而看不起我。

en.t: I merely laughed it off, but in my heart I knew very well that K despised me for it.
